title: Motorola Signature 27 is official, Honor Magic9 Pro Max at HQ, Week 45 in review
description: Motorola finally made the Signature 27 fully official this week, revealing a 7,000mAh silicon-carbon battery with 90W wired and 50W wireless charging. The flagship is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and features a 6.78-inch 120Hz tandem OLED display with up to 12,000 nits of peak brightness, alongside up to 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage. The camera setup includes a 50MP main camera with Sony's Lytia 910 sensor and LOFIC technology, a 200MP 3x periscope telephoto, and a 50MP ultrawide. There's also a dedicated EVS action sensor designed to help capture fast-moving...

title: Inside ARRI: From Hollywood cinema cameras to the Honor Magic9 Pro Max
description: What does a $100,000 cinema camera have in common with a smartphone that's a hundred times cheaper? Honor recently invited us to California to answer that question by lifting the veil on the breadth and depth of its collaboration with renowned German camera manufacturer ARRI on the image science behind the Magic9 Pro Max. We had the rare opportunity to take a guided tour of ARRI's facility in Burbank, just outside Hollywood, exploring the company's heritage, its role in modern filmmaking, and some fascinating stories from its history. There was plenty to geek out over. The equipment...

title: Deals: Latest Samsung foldables, Pixel 11 series, and more discounted
description: This week, Samsung’s latest Galaxy Z foldables, the Galaxy S26 Ultra, and the Galaxy S26 FE are on sale on Amazon UK. They’re joined by the entire Pixel 11 series, including the Pixel 11 Pro Fold. Meanwhile, discounts are also available on the Motorola Razr 70, Apple’s iPhone 17, the Oppo Reno16 Pro, and the Xiaomi 17T series. title: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL vs Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
description: Looking for a premium Android flagship? The Google Pixel 11 Pro XL and Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra are two compelling options, but they take rather different approaches. Google's latest Pixel emphasizes its camera experience and tightly integrated Google software, while Samsung offers more powerful hardware, a broader feature set, and extras like Privacy Display and the S Pen. And due to the fact that the Galaxy is now the older model, it can now be found at a lower price. But does Samsung's hardware advantage translate into a better overall experience? And which phone comes out ahead in our...

title: Deals: vivo X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max come with freebies, the Oppo Find X10 series has a small discount
description: The quality of cameras has reached stunning heights – and so have the prices of said phones. AI-driven memory price increases are certainly to blame, but those 200MP sensors aren’t cheap either and there are a lot of them. The vivo X500 series went global at the end of October, led by the vivo X500 Pro Max. It has some of the best cameras (especially when it comes to video), check our review for more details. The Pro Max offers a 50MP main camera (1/1.28” Sony Lytia L910 LOFIC sensor), a 200MP telephoto (1/1.4” Samsung ISOCELL HP0) with a 3.5x/85mm lens and a 50MP ultra-wide (1/2.75”...

title: Weekly poll: are you interested in the Motorola Signature 27?
description: For a while there, it felt like Motorola had given up on flagships, at least the non-folding kind. The Motorola Signature 27 is a return to form for the storied smartphone maker (the phone’s shape is kind of reminiscent of the old Droid Razrs, isn’t it?). Among its many other impressive specs, this is the first Moto that supports GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused fork of Android that lets you decide how much Google you want in your life. The previous Signature was a fine phone, but it had a few weak spots – the 27 model is a proper beast. Starting with the chipset, the previous model used the...

title: Weekly poll results: touchscreens on laptops only make sense if you can use the laptop as a tablet
description: The results from last week’s poll show that touchscreens do have a place on some laptops. It’s mainly the ones with a 360° hinge or the ones where the screen can detach from the keyboard – in other words, the laptops that can be used as a tablet. According to commenters, a touchscreen enables quick and easy navigation – especially for people who don’t like using a touchpad. Also, it has clear applications for artists, designers and developers. The second-largest voting block has no need for a touchscreen on a laptop and is mainly concerned with not paying extra for a feature that they...

title: vivo X500 Ultra on track to launch next year, says tipster
description: Tipster Digital Chat Station recently said that the Oppo Find X10 Ultra is on hold and might not launch. Before that, we heard Xiaomi had canceled the 18 Ultra. This left some wondering whether vivo would also cancel its X500 Ultra, despite vivo's VP of Product confirming that the smartphone would arrive next year in March or April in China. That confirmation came in September, and plans can always change. The good news is, the vivo X500 Ultra is still on track. This information comes from Digital Chat Station, who also said that the X500 Ultra is expected to launch next March or April -...

title: Deals: Galaxy S26 Ultra and S25 Ultra on sale, Galaxy Z Fold8 price drops
description: Patience pays off – some flagships were holding a fairly high price last week, but now they are down to a much better number. That is the case for the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra – a 256GB unit was $1,105 last week, now it’s $1,000. We’ve seen it as low as $950 not too long ago, but the $50 difference isn’t huge. title: OnePlus releases its ColorOS 17 rollout schedule for November
description: With ColorOS 17, OnePlus officially kickstarts the transition from OxygenOS to ColorOS, but not all devices are running the latest version of the software based on Android 17. After the company updated the OnePlus 15 in late October, it's now time for the older models. The company released the update schedule for November, listing all the devices that are about to receive ColorOS 17. The first one that already got the update is the OnePlus 13R - two days ago on November 5. If you still haven't received the update, wait a few more days, as it might be a staged rollout. The second in...

title: Google to add vocabulary for corrected words to Gboard's Rambler voice typing feature
description: Android Authority app teardown reveals some cool new features coming to Gboard's AI-powered voice typing feature called Rambler. Rambler, however, is a Pixel-exclusive functionality, at least for now, and makes voice typing that much easier. It can leave out pauses or other filler words, but it can't remember corrected words or slang from your personal vocabulary. That's about to change, though. title: Xiaomi 18 might actually arrive this year, 3C reveals the charging capabilities
description: The Xiaomi 18 Pro series was announced in China in September, and the company confirmed that the duo is going global by the end of this year. In fact, we expect the Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max to hit the global market as early as this month. However, the conversation left out the vanilla Xiaomi 18 entirely, stirring speculation that we won't be getting a Xiaomi 17 successor this year. A 3C listing suggests otherwise, and it appears to be in line with earlier rumors that the Xiaomi 18 will arrive at a later date, probably sometime in December. That timeframe likely refers to the...

title: WhatsApp is testing a feature that lets you control who sees your phone number
description: WhatsApp introduced the Username feature in June. It hasn't been fully rolled out yet, but users can already reserve their usernames. WhatsApp introduced usernames with a focus on privacy, allowing its users to communicate without knowing each other's phone numbers. Building on that, WhatsApp is now testing a feature that grants users granular control over their phone number visibility. This revelation comes from WABetaInfo, which discovered the development in beta version 2.26.45.1 of WhatsApp for Android. The publication reports that WhatsApp's new privacy feature for phone numbers has...

title: We now have a more definite timeframe for Samsung Galaxy Buds On's Europe launch
description: The Samsung Galaxy Buds On wireless earphones, unveiled last month, are currently only available in South Korea and the US. Samsung said the Buds On would come to Europe in early 2027 without getting specific. Well, we now have a more definite timeframe for the Galaxy Buds On's European debut. Citing their sources, SamMobile claims the Samsung Galaxy Buds On will launch in Europe in the third week of 2027. We still don't have the launch date, but at least we now have a more definite launch timeframe. The Galaxy Buds On are Samsung's first clip-on earphones. They are priced at...

title: iOS 27 users report HDMI output issues and there's no fix in sight
description: As is usually the case with new software releases, rollouts rarely go smoothly, and developers work overtime to provide fixes. One problem that gained a lot of traction is the Apple Intelligence storage issue that occupies about 15GB in some cases, even if you don't use AI or it's not available at all in your country. At least there's a workaround that seems to work until Apple addresses it. The same cannot be said about this annoying bug causing problems with the HDMI output. title: New Realme 17 Pro spec leak helps clarify its place in the upcoming lineup
description: Some key specs for an upcoming Realme 17 Pro-series phone leaked last month, but its identity wasn't clear - it could have been either the Pro or the Pro+. Today, a new report citing industry sources specifically details the Realme 17 Pro, and the differences suggest the earlier leak may have described its higher-end sibling. The 17 Pro will allegedly come with a 1.5K AMOLED screen with a 120Hz refresh rate, the Dimensity 7300 chipset, a 50MP main camera, and an 8MP ultrawide. The selfie camera will support 4K video recording at 30fps, although its resolution is unclear - it could be...

title: Future iPhones will have one less button, new rumor claims
description: Apple introduced the Action button with the iPhone 15 Pro, and the iPhone 18 Pro still has it. Now, a tipster on Weibo claims the company is planning to combine the Action button and the Camera Control into a single button on next year's iPhones. The dedicated Action button will allegedly start disappearing from new iPhones in the second half of 2027. Its functions will move to the Camera Control, with a single press opening the Camera app and a long press triggering the shortcut assigned to the Action button. The tipster specifically stresses that it's the Action button going away, not...

title: Airbnb is building an AI travel agent that designs its own interface
description: Airbnb has spent much of 2026 folding AI into search, listing descriptions, and customer support. Now, in its Q3 2026 shareholder letter, the company says it's building a specialized AI agent meant to help guests plan and book trips, with a rollout planned for the first half of 2027. Airbnb doesn't think a traditional chatbot is the right way to plan a trip. Instead, it's developing a custom, AI-native experience that "builds the interface around your question." Rather than a chat window, the agent pulls from a library of hundreds of travel-specific elements - maps, photos, comparisons,...

title: Apple says over 100,000 apps are now optimized for the iPhone Duo
description: The iPhone Duo started shipping about two weeks ago, and app support has been one of the early talking points. Today, Apple claims there are already well over 100,000 apps built for the foldable live on the App Store, with thousands of optimized titles being added each day. [#InlinePriceWidget,13804,1#] Susan Prescott, Apple's vice president of Worldwide Developer Relations, says developers have moved quickly to embrace the handset. title: Samsung Display tipped to lead OLED supply for 2027 iPad Air
description: The latest versions of the iPad Pro and iPad mini already sport OLED screens, but the current 11-inch and 13-inch iPad Air are stuck with LCD panels. Today, industry sources in Korea are claiming that the first OLED iPad Air models are due in the first half of 2027 - which lines up with earlier reporting. These Korean sources put 2027 OLED iPad shipment outlooks at 3 to 4 million Pro units, 4 to 5 million mini units, and 4 to 5 million Air units.
